A moment of pride for the legendary actress Lillete Dubey, honoured with the prestigious Honour of Ashoka Award 2026 in recognition of her outstanding contribution to Indian theatre and cinema. 🎭 With her exceptional talent, powerful performances, and unwavering dedication to the performing arts, she continues to inspire generations of artists and audiences alike. Her remarkable journey reflects the true spirit of creativity, excellence, and passion. Celebrating Excellence, Passion & Artistic Legacy!
